# Atlas One v40.1

> Unified intelligent operations platform — frozen release v40.1

## Architecture Overview

Atlas One v40.1 is a cloud-native, event-driven microservices platform composed of:

| Layer | Components |
|---|---|
| **API Gateway** | Route orchestration, auth middleware, rate limiting, TLS termination |
| **Identity** | JWT/OIDC issuance, RBAC, tenant isolation, MFA, API key management |
| **Provenance** | Immutable audit chains, supply-chain attestation, hash anchoring |
| **Food Defense** | Threat scoring engine, anomaly detection, rule-based alert dispatch |
| **Event Mesh** | NATS-based async bindings, consumer groups, dead-letter handling |
| **Vertical Adapters** | Retail, Logistics, Foodservice, Healthcare domain adapters |
| **Config Service** | Runtime feature flags, environment-scoped config, hot-reload |
| **Audit Logger** | Structured JSON audit trail, tamper-evident log chaining |

## Repository Structure

```
atlas-one-v40.1/
├── .github/workflows/        # CI/CD pipelines
├── services/                 # Core microservices
│   ├── api-gateway/
│   ├── identity/
│   ├── provenance/
│   ├── food-defense/
│   ├── event-mesh/
│   ├── audit-logger/
│   └── config-service/
├── adapters/                 # Vertical domain adapters
│   ├── vertical-retail/
│   ├── vertical-logistics/
│   ├── vertical-foodservice/
│   └── vertical-healthcare/
├── infra/
│   ├── k8s/                  # Kubernetes manifests (Kustomize)
│   └── helm/                 # Helm chart
├── sdk/                      # Client SDKs
│   ├── node/
│   └── python/
├── shared/                   # Proto definitions, schemas, constants
├── scripts/                  # Operational scripts
└── docs/                     # Architecture docs
```

## Quick Start

```bash
# Clone and bootstrap
git clone https://github.com/your-org/atlas-one.git
cd atlas-one-v40.1

# Start all services locally
docker compose up --build

# Run integration tests
./scripts/run-tests.sh

# Deploy to staging
./scripts/deploy.sh staging
```

## Version

`v40.1.0` — Frozen architecture. See `docs/CHANGELOG.md` for details.

version: "3.9"

name: atlas-one

x-common-env: &common-env
  NODE_ENV: development
  LOG_LEVEL: debug
  OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: http://otel-collector:4318

x-healthcheck-defaults: &hc-defaults
  interval: 15s
  timeout: 5s
  retries: 5
  start_period: 20s

services:
  # ── Infrastructure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: atlas
      POSTGRES_USER: atlas
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: atlaslocal
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./scripts/init-db.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql
    ports: ["5432:5432"]
    healthcheck:
      <<: *hc-defaults
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U atlas"]

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports: ["6379:6379"]
    command: redis-server --save 60 1 --loglevel warning
    volumes: [redisdata:/data]
    healthcheck:
      <<: *hc-defaults
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]

  nats:
    image: nats:2.10-alpine
    ports:
      - "4222:4222"   # client
      - "8222:8222"   # monitoring
    command: ["-js", "-m", "8222"]
    healthcheck:
      <<: *hc-defaults
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:8222/healthz"]

  vault:
    image: hashicorp/vault:1.17
    ports: ["8200:8200"]
    environment:
      VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN_ID: atlas-dev-root
      VAULT_DEV_LISTEN_ADDRESS: 0.0.0.0:8200
    cap_add: [IPC_LOCK]

  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.104.0
    volumes:
      - ./infra/otel-collector.yml:/etc/otel-collector-config.yaml
    command: ["--config=/etc/otel-collector-config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP
      - "9090:9090"   # Prometheus scrape

  # ── Core Services ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  api-gateway:
    build:
      context: services/api-gateway
      target: development
    ports: ["3000:3000"]
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      PORT: 3000
      IDENTITY_SERVICE_URL: http://identity:3001
      PROVENANCE_SERVICE_URL: http://provenance:3002
      FOOD_DEFENSE_SERVICE_URL: http://food-defense:3003
      CONFIG_SERVICE_URL: http://config-service:3005
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_URL: http://identity:3001/.well-known/jwks.json
    volumes: ["./services/api-gateway:/app", "/app/node_modules"]
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      redis: {condition: service_healthy}
      identity: {condition: service_started}
    healthcheck:
      <<: *hc-defaults
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:3000/health"]

  identity:
    build:
      context: services/identity
      target: development
    ports: ["3001:3001"]
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      PORT: 3001
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://atlas:atlaslocal@postgres:5432/atlas
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      VAULT_ADDR: http://vault:8200
      VAULT_TOKEN: atlas-dev-root
      JWT_ISSUER: https://identity.atlas-one.local
      JWT_AUDIENCE: atlas-one
      JWT_ACCESS_TTL: 900
      JWT_REFRESH_TTL: 86400
      NATS_URL: nats://nats:4222
    volumes: ["./services/identity:/app", "/app/node_modules"]
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      redis: {condition: service_healthy}
      vault: {condition: service_started}
    healthcheck:
      <<: *hc-defaults
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:3001/health"]

  provenance:
    build:
      context: services/provenance
      target: development
    ports: ["3002:3002"]
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      PORT: 3002
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://atlas:atlaslocal@postgres:5432/atlas
      NATS_URL: nats://nats:4222
      HASH_ALGORITHM: sha256
      ANCHOR_INTERVAL_MS: 30000
    volumes: ["./services/provenance:/app", "/app/node_modules"]
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      nats: {condition: service_healthy}

  food-defense:
    build:
      context: services/food-defense
      target: development
    ports: ["3003:3003"]
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      PORT: 3003
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://atlas:atlaslocal@postgres:5432/atlas
      NATS_URL: nats://nats:4222
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      THREAT_SCORE_THRESHOLD: 75
      ANOMALY_WINDOW_SECS: 300
    volumes: ["./services/food-defense:/app", "/app/node_modules"]
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      nats: {condition: service_healthy}

  event-mesh:
    build:
      context: services/event-mesh
      target: development
    ports: ["3004:3004"]
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      PORT: 3004
      NATS_URL: nats://nats:4222
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      DEAD_LETTER_SUBJECT: atlas.dlq
      MAX_REDELIVERY: 5
      ACK_WAIT_SECS: 30
    volumes: ["./services/event-mesh:/app", "/app/node_modules"]
    depends_on:
      nats: {condition: service_healthy}

  audit-logger:
    build:
      context: services/audit-logger
      target: development
    ports: ["3006:3006"]
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      PORT: 3006
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://atlas:atlaslocal@postgres:5432/atlas
      NATS_URL: nats://nats:4222
      CHAIN_HASH_ALGORITHM: sha256
    volumes: ["./services/audit-logger:/app", "/app/node_modules"]
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      nats: {condition: service_healthy}

  config-service:
    build:
      context: services/config-service
      target: development
    ports: ["3005:3005"]
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      PORT: 3005
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://atlas:atlaslocal@postgres:5432/atlas
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      NATS_URL: nats://nats:4222
      HOT_RELOAD: "true"
    volumes: ["./services/config-service:/app", "/app/node_modules"]
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
      redis: {condition: service_healthy}

name: Atlas One CD

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: "Target environment"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [staging, prod]
      version:
        description: "Image tag / git ref to deploy"
        required: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy to ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    environment: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Setup kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v3
        with:
          version: "v1.30.0"

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: aws eks update-kubeconfig --name atlas-one-${{ github.event.inputs.environment }} --region us-east-1

      - name: Kustomize build & apply
        working-directory: infra/k8s/overlays/${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}
        env:
          IMAGE_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
        run: |
          kustomize edit set image "ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-api-gateway=ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-api-gateway:${IMAGE_TAG}"
          kustomize edit set image "ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-identity=ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-identity:${IMAGE_TAG}"
          kustomize edit set image "ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-provenance=ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-provenance:${IMAGE_TAG}"
          kustomize edit set image "ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-food-defense=ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-food-defense:${IMAGE_TAG}"
          kustomize edit set image "ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-event-mesh=ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-event-mesh:${IMAGE_TAG}"
          kustomize edit set image "ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-audit-logger=ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-audit-logger:${IMAGE_TAG}"
          kustomize edit set image "ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-config-service=ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one-config-service:${IMAGE_TAG}"
          kustomize build . | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Wait for rollout
        run: |
          for svc in api-gateway identity provenance food-defense event-mesh audit-logger config-service; do
            kubectl rollout status deployment/atlas-one-${svc} -n atlas-one --timeout=300s
          done

      - name: Smoke tests
        run: ./scripts/smoke-test.sh ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}

      - name: Notify Slack
        if: always()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1
        with:
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "Atlas One deploy to ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }} (${{ github.event.inputs.version }}): ${{ job.status }}"
            }
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}

name: Atlas One CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop, "release/**"]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_PREFIX: ${{ github.repository_owner }}/atlas-one

jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    name: Lint & Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        service:
          - api-gateway
          - identity
          - provenance
          - food-defense
          - event-mesh
          - audit-logger
          - config-service
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: services/${{ matrix.service }}/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: services/${{ matrix.service }}
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        working-directory: services/${{ matrix.service }}
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Unit tests
        working-directory: services/${{ matrix.service }}
        run: npm test -- --coverage

      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-${{ matrix.service }}
          path: services/${{ matrix.service }}/coverage/

  adapter-tests:
    name: Adapter Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        adapter: [vertical-retail, vertical-logistics, vertical-foodservice, vertical-healthcare]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: adapters/${{ matrix.adapter }}/package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
        working-directory: adapters/${{ matrix.adapter }}
      - run: npm test
        working-directory: adapters/${{ matrix.adapter }}

  integration-tests:
    name: Integration Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    needs: [lint-and-test]
    services:
      nats:
        image: nats:2.10-alpine
        ports: ["4222:4222"]
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports: ["6379:6379"]
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: atlas_test
          POSTGRES_USER: atlas
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: atlastest
        ports: ["5432:5432"]
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - run: npm ci
        working-directory: services/api-gateway
      - name: Run integration suite
        env:
          NATS_URL: nats://localhost:4222
          REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://atlas:atlastest@localhost:5432/atlas_test
          NODE_ENV: test
        run: ./scripts/run-integration-tests.sh

  build-images:
    name: Build & Push Images
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    needs: [lint-and-test, adapter-tests]
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    strategy:
      matrix:
        service:
          - api-gateway
          - identity
          - provenance
          - food-defense
          - event-mesh
          - audit-logger
          - config-service
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Log in to registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_PREFIX }}-${{ matrix.service }}
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=sha,prefix=sha-,format=short

      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: services/${{ matrix.service }}
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  security-scan:
    name: Security Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    needs: [build-images]
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          scan-type: "fs"
          scan-ref: "."
          format: "sarif"
          output: "trivy-results.sarif"
          severity: "CRITICAL,HIGH"
      - name: Upload Trivy SARIF
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        with:
          sarif_file: "trivy-results.sarif"

# Atlas One v40.1 — Architecture Reference

## Overview

Atlas One v40.1 is a cloud-native, event-driven microservices platform built for intelligent food safety, supply-chain provenance, and identity governance across multiple verticals.

## Service Topology

```
                         ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
                         │                 EXTERNAL CLIENTS                            │
                         │   Browser / Mobile / Partner Systems / Vertical Adapters    │
                         └────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                  │ HTTPS
                         ┌────────────────────────▼────────────────────────────────────┐
                         │               API GATEWAY  :3000                            │
                         │  Auth middleware · Rate limiting · Tenant isolation ·        │
                         │  Route proxying · JWKS caching · OpenTelemetry tracing      │
                         └───┬──────────┬──────────┬──────────┬────────────────────────┘
                             │          │          │          │
             ┌───────────────▼──┐  ┌────▼────┐ ┌──▼──────┐ ┌▼────────────┐
             │ IDENTITY  :3001  │  │ PROV.   │ │ FOOD-   │ │ CONFIG      │
             │ JWT/OIDC · RBAC  │  │ :3002   │ │ DEFENSE │ │ SERVICE     │
             │ MFA · API Keys   │  │ Chain   │ │ :3003   │ │ :3005       │
             │ Tenant mgmt      │  │ Merkle  │ │ Threat  │ │ Feature     │
             │ Session store    │  │ Attestation│Scoring  │ │ Flags       │
             └──────────────────┘  │ Anchor  │ │ Rules   │ └─────────────┘
                                   └────┬────┘ └──┬──────┘
                                        │          │
                         ┌──────────────▼──────────▼──────────────────────────────────┐
                         │            EVENT MESH  :3004  (NATS JetStream)             │
                         │  atlas.> subjects · Consumer groups · DLQ · Retry backoff  │
                         └──────┬────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────┘
                                │                                │
                    ┌───────────▼──────────┐      ┌─────────────▼───────────┐
                    │  AUDIT LOGGER :3006  │      │   VERTICAL ADAPTERS     │
                    │  Tamper-evident      │      │   Retail   · Logistics  │
                    │  SHA-256 hash chain  │      │   Foodservice · Healthcare│
                    │  Chain verification  │      └─────────────────────────┘
                    └──────────────────────┘
```

## Data Stores

| Store    | Usage |
|---|---|
| **PostgreSQL 16** | All persistent data: users, tenants, provenance chains, food-defense events/alerts, audit log, config flags |
| **Redis 7** | Sessions, rate-limit counters, JWT JWKS cache, food-defense baselines, config flag cache, DLQ tracking |
| **NATS 2.10** | Event mesh — async messaging, JetStream streams, consumer groups, DLQ |
| **Vault 1.17** | JWT private/public key pairs, database credentials (production) |

## Event Flow

```
Vertical Adapter ingests event
    │
    ├─► atlas.provenance.record.created  (all events)
    └─► atlas.food-defense.event.ingest  (food-safety events only)
            │
            ├─► Food Defense Service: score + rule evaluation
            │       └─► atlas.food-defense.alert.created  (if threshold exceeded)
            │
            └─► Audit Logger: tamper-evident log append
```

## Security Model

- **Authentication**: RS256 JWT tokens issued by Identity service, validated at API Gateway via JWKS
- **Authorization**: RBAC — roles + permissions resolved at login, embedded in JWT claims
- **Tenant Isolation**: All data scoped by `tenant_id`; gateway enforces header/claim consistency
- **API Keys**: SHA-256 hashed at rest, never stored in plaintext; prefix shown for identification
- **MFA**: TOTP (RFC 6238) via otplib; backup codes generated at enrollment
- **Transport**: TLS terminated at ingress; internal service-to-service over cluster network policy
- **Secrets**: Vault-backed key management; Kubernetes secrets for non-sensitive config

## Provenance Chain Integrity

Each record includes:
1. `hash` = SHA-256(id + entityType + entityId + eventType + payload + actorId + previousHash + sequenceNumber)
2. `previousHash` = hash of the immediately prior record in the same (tenant, entityType, entityId) chain
3. Periodic Merkle anchor checkpoints batch-hash sets of records and publish root to event mesh

Chain verification walks the chain sequentially re-computing hashes and checking linkage. Any modification is detectable.

## Food Defense Scoring

Threat score (0–100) is computed from three weighted factors:
1. **Event type × severity** (up to ~90 pts depending on event class)
2. **Event frequency** in rolling window vs. baseline (up to 30 pts)
3. **Facility risk profile** from database (up to 15 pts)

Score ranges → threat levels:
| Score | Level | Action |
|---|---|---|
| 0–39 | 🟢 Green | Log only |
| 40–64 | 🟡 Yellow | Increase monitoring |
| 65–84 | 🟠 Orange | Notify food safety officer |
| 85–100 | 🔴 Red | Immediate escalation + recall protocol |

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Atlas One v40.1 — Deployment Script
# Usage: ./scripts/deploy.sh <environment> [image-tag]
set -euo pipefail

ENV="${1:-staging}"
TAG="${2:-40.1.0}"
NAMESPACE="atlas-one"

if [[ ! "$ENV" =~ ^(dev|staging|prod)$ ]]; then
  echo "❌  Invalid environment: $ENV  (dev | staging | prod)"
  exit 1
fi

echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
echo "  Atlas One v40.1 — Deploying to: $ENV  (tag: $TAG)"
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"

OVERLAY_DIR="infra/k8s/overlays/${ENV}"

# ── Pre-flight checks ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v kubectl   >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "kubectl not found"; exit 1; }
command -v kustomize >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "kustomize not found"; exit 1; }

# Verify cluster connectivity
kubectl cluster-info --request-timeout=5s >/dev/null || { echo "Cannot reach cluster"; exit 1; }

# ── Update image tags in overlay ──────────────────────────────────────────────
SERVICES=(api-gateway identity provenance food-defense event-mesh audit-logger config-service)
for svc in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
  kustomize edit set image \
    "ghcr.io/your-org/atlas-one-${svc}=ghcr.io/your-org/atlas-one-${svc}:${TAG}" \
    --kustomization-path "${OVERLAY_DIR}/kustomization.yaml"
done

# ── Apply manifests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "▶  Applying kustomize overlay: $OVERLAY_DIR"
kustomize build "$OVERLAY_DIR" | kubectl apply -f -

# ── Wait for rollouts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "⏳  Waiting for rollouts..."
for svc in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
  echo "    → atlas-one-${svc}"
  kubectl rollout status deployment/atlas-one-${svc} \
    -n "$NAMESPACE" --timeout=300s
done

# ── Smoke test ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "🔍  Running smoke tests..."
./scripts/smoke-test.sh "$ENV"

echo ""
echo "✅  Deployment to $ENV complete (tag: $TAG)"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Atlas One v40.1 — Full test runner
set -euo pipefail

echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"

run_tests() {
  local dir="$1"
  local label="$2"
  echo ""
  echo "▶  Testing: $label"
  if npm test --prefix "$dir" -- --passWithNoTests 2>&1; then
    echo "  ✅  $label passed"
  else
    echo "  ❌  $label FAILED"
    FAILED+=("$label")
  fi
}

for svc in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do

  run_tests "adapters/$adp" "adapter/$adp"

else

  for f in "${FAILED[@]}"; do echo "       - $f"; done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Atlas One v40.1 — Smoke Test Script
# Usage: ./scripts/smoke-test.sh <environment>
set -euo pipefail

ENV="${1:-staging}"
PASS=0
FAIL=0

case "$ENV" in
  dev)     BASE_URL="http://localhost:3000" ;;
  staging) BASE_URL="https://api-staging.atlas-one.io" ;;
  prod)    BASE_URL="https://api.atlas-one.io" ;;
  *)       BASE_URL="http://localhost:3000" ;;
esac

echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
echo "  Atlas One v40.1 — Smoke Tests ($ENV)"
echo "  Base URL: $BASE_URL"
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"

check() {
  local name="$1"
  local expected_status="$2"
  local url="$3"
  local method="${4:-GET}"
  local body="${5:-}"

  if [[ -n "$body" ]]; then
    actual=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X "$method" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d "$body" \
      --max-time 10 "$url")
  else
    actual=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X "$method" \
      --max-time 10 "$url")
  fi

  if [[ "$actual" == "$expected_status" ]]; then
    echo "  ✅  $name (HTTP $actual)"
    PASS=$((PASS + 1))
  else
    echo "  ❌  $name — expected HTTP $expected_status, got $actual"
    FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
  fi
}
